definitions.explanation: A visible mass of water droplets or ice crystals suspended in the atmosphere. Appears white or gray in the sky.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}に{雲|くも}がありません。
examples.english: There are no clouds in the sky.
There are many clouds, aren't there?

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い{雲|くも}がきれいです。

notes: Related to the verb {曇|くも}る (to become cloudy). Don't confuse with {蜘蛛|くも} (spider), which has the same reading. Context and kanji make the distinction clear.
